[IDSP.14.1] `ds_dispatch_t` is a fixed C struct that
provides compiled RHS functions (`CompiledCode` atoms) with direct
access to the dispatcher entry points (the same
`ds_dispatcher_<verb>` functions the Rete action adapters
call).  Its field layout matches the slot
table embedded at the front of every `CODE_KIND_RHS` blob
body (RAOT.6); the `CompiledCode` atom loader populates the in-blob
slot table by copying live function addresses from
`engine->dispatch_table` at mmap time.
